zh-Hans:
1.7.0 (179)
手记文件封面支持 Word、Excel、PPT（系统 Quick Look 生成）并可导入 DXF／DWG 图纸查看只读 CAD 预览。调整了 Office 字体选择、关闭和保存处理；遇到外部修改时保留冲突选择，画笔参数按文档保存。IDE 可直接运行当前文件：先保存、可停止，Rust／Swift 等语言在已配置主机上运行。Shell 可用 apt install floe/lua 安装签名 Lua 5.4.8 运行时（支持 search/list/show 与 lua 别名）。图纸编辑滚动时保留保存控件。调整了本地模型的内存释放策略。

请重点测试：手记中 Office 封面与图纸导入显示；Office 编辑、保存、关闭与画笔设置重开；IDE 运行与停止；Shell 安装并运行 Lua。已知限制：iPad 本地模型聊天崩溃仍待真机复核，未确认根治；PHP 浏览器原型未包含；Office 原生交互与 IDE 远端运行仍需真机验收。
en-US:
1.7.0 (179)
The Notes library renders Word, Excel and PPT covers (system Quick Look) and imports DXF/DWG drawings with a read-only CAD preview. Updated Office font selection, closing and saving; external changes keep the conflict decision available, and annotation settings persist per document. The IDE can run the current file: save first, stop supported, with Rust/Swift and other hosted languages running on a configured host. Shell installs the signed Lua 5.4.8 runtime via apt install floe/lua (search/list/show and a lua alias). Drawing editors keep Save visible while scrolling. Updated local-model memory release behavior.

Focus testing: Office covers and drawing import in Notes; Office editing, saving, closing and annotate settings after reopen; IDE run and stop; installing and running Lua from Shell. Known limits: the iPad local-model chat crash remains unconfirmed as fixed pending device re-test; the PHP browser prototype is not included; native Office interaction and remote IDE runs still need device acceptance.
